name: Green sprouts
description: Whole green moong, soaked overnight and sprouted fresh.
facts: Eaten raw with lemon and salt, or lightly steamed
Keeps about two days in the fridge

name: Mixed sprouts
facts: Chana gives it more bite than plain moong
Goes into salads, chaat, chapati fillings and cooked vegetables

name: Chana sprouts
facts: The most filling of the sprouts
Works as an evening snack on its own

name: Mixed fruit bowl
description: Seasonal fruit, cut fresh the same morning.
facts: Cut and ready, so nobody has to find time to prepare it
Whatever is in season that week
Best eaten the day it is bought

name: Bananas
description: Fresh bananas, sold by the dozen.
facts: Needs no cutting, no cooking and no plate
Easy to carry and easy to digest
Good before or after physical work
